text:
alex: Quick sync — aiming to cut a coordinated version bump to 0.15.0 for api, runtime, console, and js-sdk by EOD today (18:00 PT). Goal: single release window, minimal runtime compatibility churn.

maria: Are we confident there are no public API changes that need a deprecation window?

alex: No breaking HTTP surface changes. Runtime does have a small kv-cache key schema tweak but it's backward-compatible if you bump client+server together. That's why we need the coordinated cut.

dmitri: The runtime change toggles a config flag — requires runtime binary + runtime-api client to land together. I've got the PR: PR #789-runtime-kv-key-shim. Needs a console readout change to expose the flag.

keisha: js-sdk needs a tiny patch to pick the new header name, PR #133-sdk-header-bump. It's a one-line change. Can someone review?

sam: I can take SDK review in 15m. Also will draft the changelog entry (short note + migration hint). Where should I drop it?

alex: Put changelog in each repo under CHANGELOG.md (top of file) and also paste a short blurb in the release notes doc: https://redwood/release/notes/0.15.0 (internal). Keep the SDK note: "rename x-client-key header -> x-rw-kv-key" with example.

release-bot: CI check triggered for PRs: #789, #133, #411-console-flag. Status: pending.

ci-bot: All CI green for #133 and #411-console-flag. #789 has a flaky integration test (kv-store-smoke). Re-running.

dmitri: Repro of flaky test is intermittent on p3-small runners. I'm investigating but safe to rerun and merge on green.

maria: ETA for docs update? Need to update API compatibility matrix in the console docs too.

keisha: I'll add the SDK blurb and the example snippet in docs/sdk/upgrade.md now.

sam: SDK review done, approved. @keisha you can merge once runtime CI is green.

ci-bot: #789 rerun passed. All green now.

alex: Okay — plan: owners merge in this order to avoid regressions: 1) runtime (PR #789) -> 2) api (PR #411) -> 3) console (PR #411-console-flag) -> 4) js-sdk (PR #133). Merge window open until 18:00 PT. If anything slips past 18:00 we hold to next maintenance window (tomorrow 10:00 PT).

dmitri: Pushing runtime merge now. Will tag v0.15.0-runtime and then create the release candidate.

keisha: Merged #133 (js-sdk). Changelog updated.

sam: I added the combined release notes draft here: https://redwood/release/drafts/0.15.0. Short summary + migration steps. Please add any missing items before 17:30 PT.

maria: Console patch landed, updated compatibility matrix. Thanks.

release-bot: Release candidate builds created: rc/runtime-0.15.0, rc/api-0.15.0, rc/console-0.15.0, rc/js-sdk-0.15.0. Smoke tests are running.

ci-bot: Smoke tests: runtime=pass, api=pass, console=pass, js-sdk=pass.

alex: Great. Final pre-cut checklist: changelogs in repos (done), release notes draft (done), all CI green (done), owners merged in correct order (done). I'll trigger the coordinated publish at 17:55 PT and tag the umbrella release 0.15.0.

dmitri: After tagging I'll flip the runtime flag to default-on in the next hour and monitor canary. If we see errors rollback plan: revert runtime tag and force-client-fallback using the old header mapping (manual).

keisha: Noted. I'll watch SDK telemetry for errors.

sam: small note: remind infra to keep rollout bandwidth at 30% for 20 minutes for canary.

alex: @infra-team can we keep canary at 30% for 20m starting at 18:00 PT?

keisha: infra acked in DMs.

maria: Anything else?

alex: If nothing else, I'm cutting at 17:55. Ping here if you see anything unexpected. :rocket:

sam: thanks all — will post the final release notes link once live. :tada:
